line: Crowley's Four of Swords is the card for the third decan of Libra, with Jupiter as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Libra.

quotes.quote: The Four of Swords is called Truce.
Chesed refers to Jupiter who rules in Libra in this decanate.

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: the card proclaims the idea of authority in the intellectual world
